info.title: CosmicForge Pharmacy API
info.description: API for pharmacy management, registration, and verification

post.description:
Creates a new pharmacy user account and associated pharmacy profile.
- Sets user role to "pharmacy" and status to "pending_email_verification".
- Creates a pharmacy profile with "pending" verification status.
- Sends a verification email (non-blocking); response indicates if email was sent successfully.
- After email verification, pharmacies must upload documents for admin approval.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The pricing config ID to delete

get.description: Returns a paginated list of pharmacies. Accessible to any authenticated user (patients, doctors, etc.) to browse and select a pharmacy.
Returns a paginated list of all pharmacies with full details. Admin access only.

post.description: Sends a request to the pharmacy to upload specific documents required for verification.

400.description: requiredDocuments must be a non-empty array

post.description:
Allows a doctor to create a new prescription during a consultation.
- Requires patient ID, medications, and consultation details.
- Generates a unique reference and sets initial status to PENDING.
- Returns the created prescription with populated relations.

get.description:
Retrieves a list of prescriptions created by the authenticated doctor.
- Supports pagination and filtering via query parameters.

post.description:
Allows a patient to upload a prescription to the platform.
- Verifies the prescription belongs to the patient and is in PENDING status.
- Updates status to PATIENT_UPLOADED.

parameters.name: prescriptionId
parameters.description: ID of the prescription to upload

post.description:
Allows a patient to assign a pharmacy to fulfill their prescription.
- Verifies the pharmacy is active and the prescription is in a valid state (PENDING or PATIENT_UPLOADED).
- Updates the prescription with pharmacy and delivery details.

get.description:
Retrieves a list of prescriptions for the authenticated patient.
- Supports pagination and filtering via query parameters.

post.description:
Allows a pharmacy to start processing an assigned prescription.
- Verifies the prescription is assigned to the pharmacy and in PHARMACY_ASSIGNED status.
- Assigns a pharmacist and updates status to PHARMACY_PROCESSING.

403.description: Forbidden - Not assigned to this pharmacy

post.description:
Allows a pharmacy to provide cost details and invoice for a prescription.
- Calculates total cost including delivery fee and updates payment information.

403.description: Forbidden - Not assigned to this pharmacy

post.description:
Allows a pharmacy to mark a prescription as ready for delivery or pickup.
- Updates status to READY_FOR_DELIVERY or READY_FOR_PICKUP.

403.description: Forbidden - Not assigned to this pharmacy

post.description:
Allows a pharmacy to mark a prescription as completed.
- Updates status to COMPLETED and sets payment status to PAID.

403.description: Forbidden - Not assigned to this pharmacy

get.description:
Retrieves active orders currently being processed by the authenticated pharmacy.
- Returns prescriptions in `pharmacy_processing`, `ready_for_delivery`, or `ready_for_pickup` status.
- Supports pagination via query parameters.

Retrieves all unique patients and doctors who have interacted with the authenticated pharmacy via prescriptions.
- Returns deduplicated lists of patients and doctors.
- Useful for building contact/communication lists within the pharmacy portal.

200.description: Unique contacts associated with the pharmacy

get.description:
Retrieves all prescriptions with invoice data for the authenticated patient.
- Only returns prescriptions where cost information has been provided (`totalDue IS NOT NULL`).
- Supports pagination via query parameters.

Retrieves a list of prescriptions assigned to the authenticated pharmacy.
- Supports pagination and filtering via query parameters.

Retrieves real-time counts for the pharmacy dashboard:
- Pending requests
- Active orders
- Completed today
Retrieves a feed of recent status changes and actions for assigned prescriptions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of activity items to retrieve

post.description: Marks a prescription as having confirmed medication stock.
Allows pharmacy staff to add private notes to a prescription.

Allows a pharmacy to suggest alternative medications when the prescribed ones are unavailable.
- Updates `availabilityStatus` to `alternatives_proposed`.
- Stores the alternatives in `internalNotes`.
- Sends a WebSocket notification and email to the patient immediately.

pharmacistId.description: Optional ID of the pharmacist proposing the alternatives

200.description: Alternatives proposed — patient notified via WebSocket and email

403.description: Forbidden — Not assigned to this pharmacy

post.description:
Allows a doctor, patient, or pharmacy to cancel a prescription.
- Requires a cancellation reason.
- Cannot cancel a completed prescription.

403.description: Forbidden - User not authorized to cancel

post.description:
Allows a patient or pharmacy to add a chat message related to a prescription.
- Verifies the sender's access to the prescription.

403.description: Forbidden - User not authorized to chat

get.description:
Retrieves a specific prescription by its ID with all related details.
- Accessible by doctors, patients, or pharmacies associated with the prescription.

Searches for prescriptions based on query parameters.
- Accessible by doctors, patients, or pharmacies.
- Supports filtering by various criteria (e.g., status, date).

get.description: Use the main application's email verification endpoint: GET /auth/verify-email
